items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: I leave there and go on that story with David Jones' band. David Jones was the greatest, one of the finest musicians that I've worked with in my life.

ctx.x: So, I played the entertainers quite a while, about two years. I leaves and go to Dallas, Texas. And Professor Cook, Professor Cook, who's a dance, dancing man, Charleston man. We go there and we take the band, we made a nice little round there. And I come on back to New Orleans and I went to Wake to see what bands I went to Wake with. I think I made up a band of my own. I went back to the La Vida Club and I leave there and go on that story with David Jones' band. David Jones was the greatest, one of the finest…
And you had another clarinet in there before or not?
